title: 4Ps & 7Ps Marketing Mix
subtitle: You're running marketing activities that feel disconnected. You're active on social media,
useWhen: have a website, and occasionally run campaigns but there's no coherent strategy pulling it all together. Something is always off.
howToUse: E. Jerome McCarthy's 4Ps Marketing Mix - Product, Price, Place, Promotion is the classic framework for building a complete marketing strategy. Booms and Bitner extended it to 7Ps for service businesses by adding People, Process, and Physical Evidence. The power of the framework is in checking coherence: if your premium pricing (Price) is contradicted by your distribution through discount channels (Place), your strategy has a gap. Every element of your marketing must reinforce the same positioning.
steps: Map your current 4Ps or 7Ps before asking AI for recommendations.
Look for contradictions between elements, incoherence is the most common marketing failure.
For service businesses, People and Process are often more important than Promotion.

Revisit your Marketing Mix after any pricing change, channel shift, or positioning update. Build a complete, coherent marketing strategy not just tactics The most neglected P in service businesses is Process. Brilliant people and strong promotion cannot compensate for a broken delivery process customers experience the process, not the strategy. Map your client delivery process before investing more in promotion. PRO TIP
origin: E. Jerome McCarthy, Basic Marketing, 1960 · Booms & Bitner, 7Ps extension, 1981
promptBody:
I PROMPT — COPY & PASTE READY
Act as a marketing strategist using the 7Ps Marketing Mix.
My business        :  [DESCRIBE YOUR PRODUCT OR SERVICE]
Target customer :  [WHO THEY ARE AND WHAT THEY VALUE]
Current stage      :  [EARLY / GROWING / SCALING]
Analyse and recommend for all 7Ps:
PRODUCT       :  What are we selling,  features and positioning
PRICE              :  How should we price, value, cost, or competitive?
PLACE             :  Where and how do customers access us?
PROMOTION  :  Which channels and messages drive awareness?
PEOPLE           :  Who delivers the experience. skills and culture
PROCESS         :  How is the service or product delivered?
PHYSICAL       :  What tangible evidence builds trust?
Flag any contradictions between elements. Identify the 2 Ps that most need improvement.
For those 2 Ps, give one specific change I should make in the next 30 days.
